events.title: Duke Energy restores 85% of Cincinnati storm outages
events.summary: Duke Energy has restored power to 85% of customers affected by severe storms in Greater Cincinnati, bringing services back to approximately 223,000 customers. As of Thursday afternoon, about 32,485 customers in Ohio and 6,376 in Kentucky were still without power, with the company expecting to restore nearly all remaining outages by Thursday. Duke Energy deployed over 2,000 workers and committed $100,000 in grants for recovery efforts, serving 8.7 million customers across six states from its Charlotte, North Carolina headquarters.

articles.headline: Duke Energy restores 85% of Cincinnati storm outages
Duke Energy Restores Major Outages in Cincinnati

events.title: Expedia acquires AI trip-planning startup
events.summary: Expedia has acquired Layla, an AI trip-planning startup, marking at least its third acquisition in the past year. This move follows previous acquisitions of online booking platform Tiqets and car rental tech company CarTrawler, signaling Expedia's continued expansion and investment in travel technology. The acquisition was reported by the Puget Sound Business Journal.

articles.headline: Expedia acquires AI trip-planning startup

events.title: AvalonBay, Equity Residential shareholders approve merger By Investing.com
events.summary: Shareholders of AvalonBay Communities, Inc. (NYSE: AVB) and Equity Residential (NYSE: EQR) have overwhelmingly approved all proposals required to complete their merger of equals. The merger is anticipated to finalize on Monday, August 17, 2026, and the combined entity will be renamed Vivmark Residential, trading under the ticker symbol VMRK on the NYSE starting August 18, 2026. Each AvalonBay share will convert into 2.793 Equity Residential common shares.

articles.headline: AvalonBay, Equity Residential shareholders approve merger By Investing.com

events.title: Michigan regulators ask lawmakers to end annual rate hikes, change how DTE, Consumers make money
events.summary: Michigan's utility regulator, the Michigan Public Service Commission (MPSC), is urging state lawmakers to end annual rate increases and revise how utilities like DTE and Consumers Energy profit. The MPSC believes this change, allowing for multi-year rate plans tied to performance, would be more effective in lowering household energy bills and improving reliability than current commission powers. This comes after four rate hikes in eight months, highlighting concerns that the current system incentivizes expensive capital projects over cheaper alternatives like maintenance and existing infrastructure optimization.

articles.headline: Michigan regulators ask lawmakers to end annual rate hikes, change how DTE, Consumers make money

events.title: This is a ‘resilient’ market, says Morgan Stanley’s Lisa Shalett
events.summary: Lisa Shalett, CIO at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, describes the current market as "resilient." She discusses market activity throughout the year and provides insights into why she uses that term. The article features a video of her discussing these points on 'Power Lunch'.

articles.headline: This is a ‘resilient’ market, says Morgan Stanley’s Lisa Shalett

events.title: Kimberly-Clark secures $45M tariff refund, half of what it paid in 2026
events.summary: Kimberly-Clark received a $45 million tariff refund in Q2 2026, which is approximately half of what it paid in North American tariffs last year. The company plans to use these funds to offset $150 million in gross input costs from rising oil prices in the second half of the year, aiming to maintain price stability. Other companies like McCormick & Co., E.l.f. Beauty, Nintendo, and Amazon have also received significant tariff refunds following the Supreme Court's nullification of certain tariffs.

articles.headline: Kimberly-Clark secures $45M tariff refund, half of what it paid in 2026

events.title: PTC Therapeutics’ $211M Bid Wins Bankruptcy Auction for Sangamo Gene Therapy
events.summary: PTC Therapeutics has won a bankruptcy auction for Sangamo Therapeutics' gene therapy candidate, isaralgagene civaparvovec (ST-920), for Fabry disease, with a bid of $111 million upfront and up to $100 million in milestone payments. This acquisition expands PTC's rare disease pipeline, bringing a therapy already in the regulatory review process with an anticipated FDA approval by 2027. The deal comes after Sangamo Therapeutics filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy following failed attempts to find strategic alternatives for its programs.

articles.headline: PTC Therapeutics’ $211M Bid Wins Bankruptcy Auction for Sangamo Gene Therapy

events.title: Parker-Hannifin Corporation (NYSE:PH) completed the acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation from Madison Capital Partners Corporation.
events.summary: Parker-Hannifin Corporation (NYSE:PH) has completed its acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation from Madison Capital Partners Corporation for $9.3 billion. The transaction, which was initially announced on November 10, 2025, excludes Filtration Group's Facet business. This acquisition is expected to boost Parker-Hannifin's organic growth, EBITDA margin, adjusted EPS, and cash flow, with a high single-digit cash ROIC projected by year five.

articles.headline: Parker-Hannifin Corporation (NYSE:PH) completed the acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation from Madison Capital Partners Corporation.

events.title: Kenvue options activity surges on bullish call bets ahead of merger news
events.summary: Kenvue Inc. (KVUE) is experiencing a surge in bullish call options activity, with over 12,000 contracts traded, indicating traders anticipate a significant upward price movement. The high concentration of calls at the $19.50 strike price, expiring soon, alongside a spike in volatility, suggests market participants are positioning for news related to the pending $40–48.7 billion acquisition by Kimberly-Clark, expected to close in Q4 2026. This aggressive options trading follows recent Q2 earnings that slightly missed estimates, implying a focus on potential merger catalysts rather than past financial performance.

articles.headline: Kenvue options activity surges on bullish call bets ahead of merger news

events.title: Centene stock holds near 52-week high as Q2 earnings beat and guidance support valuation
events.summary: Centene stock is trading near its 52-week high after reporting strong second-quarter 2026 results, which included a significant earnings beat and raised full-year guidance. The company's adjusted diluted EPS of $2.51 far exceeded estimates, and revenue grew by nearly 10% year-over-year. Centene's solid operational performance, improved balance sheet, and strategic focus on Medicaid managed care continue to underpin its valuation and future growth prospects.

articles.headline: Centene stock holds near 52-week high as Q2 earnings beat and guidance support valuation

events.title: Tariffs Are Reshaping Value Screens for Reliance, Vulcan Materials and Nucor
events.summary: Tariffs are influencing company sourcing, production, and earnings, creating opportunities for investors in domestic-oriented value stocks. This article highlights Reliance (RS), Vulcan Materials (VMC), and Nucor (NUE) as three such companies that screen well on value, balance sheet strength, and dividends, as they are closely tied to tariff-related policy shifts and domestic market advantages.

articles.headline: Tariffs Are Reshaping Value Screens for Reliance, Vulcan Materials and Nucor

events.title: Franco-Nevada Corporation

The result is an article stating that the TSX extended its record-setting run, primarily driven by gold and financial stocks. This surge was attributed to positive U.S. inflation data, an optimistic travel outlook from Air Canada, and signs of a strengthening domestic economy in Canada.

events.title: Proposed Texas Grid Projects Could Create 41,000 Jobs During Construction
events.summary: A new economic impact study commissioned by CenterPoint Energy (NYSE:CNP) suggests that its planned 765kV transmission resiliency projects in Southeast Texas could generate over $18 billion annually in economic value, create approximately 41,000 construction jobs, and add $120 million in local property taxes each year. When combined with other Texas utility projects, the statewide economic impact could reach $30 billion annually, with 100,000 construction jobs. CenterPoint Energy is currently in the early planning stages, conducting community outreach and preparing to launch "10 Commitments for Texans" to guide landowner engagement for these crucial infrastructure improvements.

articles.headline: Proposed Texas Grid Projects Could Create 41,000 Jobs During Construction

events.title: Union Pacific stock holds gains as safety concerns and freight demand shape the outlook
events.summary: Union Pacific (UNP) stock is trading near $294, reflecting investor confidence in strong freight demand despite recent local safety concerns regarding hazardous cargo transport. The company's Q2 2026 earnings showed robust revenue and net income growth, with freight revenue outpacing broad US GDP. While safety issues are noted, current market sentiment views them as manageable, with analysts expressing a stronger positive stance on the stock.

articles.headline: Union Pacific stock holds gains as safety concerns and freight demand shape the outlook

events.title: Parker Hannifin completes acquisition of Filtration Group
events.summary: Parker Hannifin Corporation has finalized its acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation. This acquisition is projected to add approximately $1.8 billion to Parker's fiscal 2027 sales and is expected to be accretive to adjusted earnings per share for the full fiscal year 2027. Parker anticipates achieving roughly $220 million in pre-tax cost synergies by the end of the third year.

articles.headline: Parker Hannifin completes acquisition of Filtration Group

events.title: Builders FirstSource stock slips after Q2 earnings miss and guidance cut
events.summary: Builders FirstSource (BLDR) stock fell after missing Q2 2026 earnings expectations and cutting its full-year revenue guidance, primarily due to a weak housing market. The company reported an 8.8% year-over-year revenue decline and significantly compressed EPS, leading to a cautious outlook from management and analysts. Despite the financial headwinds, the company's balance sheet appears manageable, and analysts still see potential upside toward a target price of $90.35 if housing demand stabilizes.

articles.headline: Builders FirstSource stock slips after Q2 earnings miss and guidance cut

events.title: Why the World Is Still Investing in America
events.summary: The article highlights a disconnect between American perceptions of their financial system and global views. While Americans often focus on volatility and decline, international governments, companies, and investors continue to seek greater access to the U.S. market, indicating strong confidence from abroad. The author, having traveled extensively, notes this contrast in perspectives.

articles.headline: Why the World Is Still Investing in America

events.title: Parker Completes Acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation
events.summary: Parker Hannifin Corporation has completed its acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation, aiming to create one of the largest global industrial filtration businesses. This strategic move is expected to strengthen Parker's global customer service capabilities, add approximately $1.8 billion to its fiscal 2027 sales, and be accretive to adjusted EPS for the full fiscal year. The integration leverages complementary filtration technologies and expands Parker's presence in key growth markets.

articles.headline: Parker Completes Acquisition of Filtration Group Corporation

events.title: DELL Stock On Track To Top $500 For First Time As AI Server Boom Gets Fresh Fuel From Lenovo, SMCI
events.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) shares are poised to exceed $500 for the first time, fueled by strong earnings from Lenovo and optimistic guidance from Super Micro Computer (SMCI), boosting confidence in the AI server market. Analysts foresee significant growth for Dell due to increasing AI demand, with Morningstar highlighting its attractive valuation and reduced business cyclicality. Both Dell and HPE are seeing "extremely bullish" retail sentiment on Stocktwits, reflecting strong year-to-date stock performance.

articles.headline: DELL Stock On Track To Top $500 For First Time As AI Server Boom Gets Fresh Fuel From Lenovo, SMCI
